description: Hidrovias no Estado de São Paulo is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização das hidrovias navegáveis no estado de São Paulo, das linhas de cabotagem - que possibilita a movimentação de cargas entre portos do Brasil -, das eclusas - que permitem a subida e descida de navios em terrenos com significativos desníveis - e dos terminais e instalações portuárias presentes no território paulista. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are hidrovia, porto, linhas, cabotagem, terminal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
